usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT), indicative exchange rates of 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid of the CBRT forex buying (49.7747) and selling (49.8644) rates for the US dollar announced on 30 October 2026; the lira lost about 19% against the dollar over the past year (Trading Economics). World Bank 2025 average 39.45.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat), CPI October 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 29.77% year on year in October 2026 (29.73% in September), released 3 November 2026; secondary source because the TurkStat bulletin could not be opened. World Bank 2025 average 34.9%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook inflation path for Türkiye (31.2% 2026, 15.0% 2030); CBRT 5% medium-term target; 2021-2025 average about 48%
inflation_projection.note: The IMF expects disinflation to about 15% by 2030 but Türkiye has missed its 5% target for many years and inflation averaged about 48% in 2021-2025, so 18% a year is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye, one-week repo rate history
policy_rate.note: One-week repo rate cut from 37% to 36% at the 22 October 2026 decision, effective 23 October; overnight lending 39% and borrowing 34.5% (Trading Economics).

savings_account_rate.note: No official figure for ordinary (demand) savings account interest was found; the CBRT weekly deposit rate statistics load only in its EVDS data system, which could not be read.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Endeks24, citing CBRT weekly deposit rate statistics (TL deposits up to 3 months, week of 16 October 2026)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Weighted average rate on new TL deposits with maturity up to 3 months, 43.22% in the week of 16 October 2026 (43.20% a week earlier); secondary source (news report of 22 October 2026) because the CBRT EVDS tables could not be read. The 22 October policy cut to 36% is not yet reflected.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Same as the 3-month rate: CBRT weekly deposit rates by maturity could not be read from EVDS.

dps_rate.note: Some banks sell accumulating (birikimli) deposit accounts, but no official or industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Endeks24, citing CBRT weekly weighted average TL deposit rate (week of 16 October 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on all new TL deposits, 42.88% in the week of 16 October 2026, down 0.06 points on the week and falling for 12 weeks; secondary source because CBRT EVDS could not be read. World Bank 2025 annual average (FR.INR.DPST) 57.6%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found; individuals can buy Treasury bonds and lease certificates through banks.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current 3-month Treasury bill yield was found; the Treasury issues few bills that short. The 2-year benchmark yield was 39.77% on 30 October 2026 (Trading Economics).

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year benchmark yield could be read (the bond yield pages tried showed only 2- and 10-year yields).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Turkey 10-year government bond yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: Market yield on 30 October 2026 (up about 2.8 points that session); secondary source.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Official Gazette (Resmî Gazete) No. 32951 of 9 July 2025, Presidential Decision 10041 amending Decision 2006/10731 (withholding under Income Tax Law provisional article 67)
tax_bank_interest.note: Decision 10041 raised the final withholding on TL demand deposits and deposits of up to 6 months from 15% to 17.5% and on deposits of up to 1 year from 12% to 15% (over 1 year stays 10%), for deposits opened or renewed from 9 July 2025; read from the gazette page image. No later change was found up to October 2026 (Decision 11444 of June 2026 only extends a temporary rate for government bonds and lease certificates). PwC Tax Summaries still shows the pre-2023 10%/7.5%/5% rates.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists. PwC lists 10% withholding on local government bonds issued after 2006; the rate for Treasury bonds held by individuals was not stated.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF), deposit insurance FAQ
deposit_insurance_limit.note: TRY 1,200,000 per person per credit institution in 2026 (950,000 in 2025), covering TL, foreign-currency and precious-metal deposits and participation funds; raised each year by the revaluation rate.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: CBRT, maximum interest rates for credit card transactions
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Legal maximum monthly contractual rate on TL card balances of TRY 30,000-180,000 is 3.75% (45% a year, simple); 3.25% below TRY 30,000 and 4.25% above TRY 180,000 or for cash advances; unchanged since January 2026 and announced for November 2026.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BIST 100 at 10,760 on 30 Oct 2026, down 1.9% on a year (Trading Economics)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Turkish shares lag the 18% inflation assumption, as in the past year when the BIST 100 fell while prices rose about 30%.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BIST 100 record (Trading Economics); inflation projection 18%; 10-year bond yield 35.9%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: a small real return above the 18% inflation assumption, since the BIST 100 has been volatile and weak in dollar terms; far below today's after-tax safe rates of over 30%.

equity_return_high.note: High case: a strong nominal run like 2020-2024, when lira share prices rose much faster than inflation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, down 3% on a year (Trading Economics); CBRT USD rate 49.82
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with the lira losing about 12% a year, below the inflation gap.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); inflation gap between Türkiye (18% assumed) and the US (about 2-3%)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises about 4% a year and the lira loses about 15% a year against the dollar, in line with the inflation gap.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); lira depreciation of 2018-2023
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold plus faster lira depreciation, as in past currency crises.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Inflation projection 18%; IMF path to 15% inflation by 2030
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: after the 15-17.5% withholding, deposits and bonds earn slightly less than inflation, as often happened in 2021-2023.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CBRT policy rate 36%; 10-year bond 35.9%; inflation projection 18%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: after-tax safe rates settle about 1 point above the 18% long-run inflation assumption, far below today's after-tax 3-month deposit rate of about 35.7% (43.2% less 17.5% withholding) as disinflation continues.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: tight monetary policy keeps real after-tax deposit and bond returns high for longer.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio from the insurance regulator (SEDDK) or the insurers' association was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, often tied to loans, but no published premium table per TRY 1,000 of cover by age from a regulator or other public source was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: General Health Insurance (GSS) covers care in public hospitals; no official figure for the typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private and complementary (tamamlayıcı) health insurance is sold, but no age-banded premium table per TRY 100,000 of cover from a public source was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Inflation projection 18%; TurkStat headline CPI 29.7% (Sep 2026, via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_health.note: No health CPI figure could be read; private medical costs are set slightly above the 18% general inflation assumption because they track imported equipment and the exchange rate.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: TurkStat education CPI +48.6% year on year in September 2026 (Finance Minister statement via Forbes Türkiye); inflation projection 18%
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose 48.6% in the year to September 2026, far above headline CPI of 29.7%, so education costs are planned 5 points above the 18% general inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.note: 2024 (older than 2025): men 74.6, women 80.3. UN WPP gives 78.4 for 2026 (georank.org).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP estimate for 2026).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 15.45 (2025, World Bank), 24.8 (2040) and 51.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/turkey/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Social Insurance and General Health Insurance Law No. 5510, Article 28
retirement_age_default.note: For people first insured after the law (2008): women 58 and men 60 until 2035, then rising two years at a time to men 65 from 2044 and women 65 from 2048, using the age in force when the premium-day requirement (7,200 days for employees) is met; so 65 applies to most people born after 1975 who started work after 2008. Earlier entrants retire under transitional rules (in practice 58-62 today).

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Social Insurance and General Health Insurance Law No. 5510, Article 28
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants first covered after 2008 fall under the same Article 28 age schedule (rising to 65), with a 9,000 premium-day requirement instead of 7,200.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Inflation projection 18%; 17.5% withholding on short TL deposit interest (Official Gazette, Decision 10041)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: a retiree's deposits earn less than inflation after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: CBRT weekly 3-month TL deposit rate 43.2% (about 35.7% after 17.5% withholding); 10-year bond 35.9%; inflation projection 18%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: safe after-tax returns about equal to long-run inflation, well below today's after-tax deposit and bond rates as rates fall with inflation.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: real rates stay high for longer.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if both shares and deposits lag inflation.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 20% and half deposits and bonds at 19%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Habertürk, 65 yaş aylığı (needs-based old-age pension) from July 2026
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: About TRY 7,257 a month for July-December 2026 (6,393 in January-June), raised 13.52% with the civil-servant salary coefficient under Law No. 2022; means-tested, paid by the Ministry of Family and Social Services. Secondary source (news report of 4 July 2026); other reports give 7,256.71.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Law No. 2022 on monthly payments to needy, disabled and destitute citizens over 65, Article 1
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid to Turkish citizens aged 65+ found needy by the social assistance foundations, with no other pension or income; not payable when household income per person exceeds one third of the net minimum wage.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Labour Law No. 1475, Article 14 (severance pay, kıdem tazminatı)
gratuity_rule.note: 30 days' gross wage for each full year of service (pro rata for part years) after at least one year with the employer, paid on retirement, dismissal other than for misconduct, military service, a woman leaving within a year of marriage, or death; capped per year at the maximum civil-servant retirement bonus.

public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory pay-as-you-go old-age insurance run by SGK (employee 14% and employer about 20.75% of pay for all SGK branches, PwC 2026). Pensions rise every January and July by the previous six months' CPI change (Article 55). Pension age rises to 65 for those first insured after 2008; tax treatment of pensions was not checked.

savings_account.note: Demand accounts pay little or no interest and their interest is taxed at 17.5%; most savers use short term deposits.

fdr_3m.note: TL deposits are insured by TMSF up to TRY 1.2 million per person per bank in 2026.

dps.note: Some banks offer accumulating deposit accounts with regular top-ups; there is no standard national scheme.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals; Treasury bonds and lease certificates can be bought through banks.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills (up to 1 year) can be bought through banks, but 3-month bills are rarely issued.

equity_fund.note: Equity and index funds are widely sold to retail investors.

gold.localNameEn: Gold bars and Republic gold coins
gold.note: Physical gold is legal and widely bought; banks also offer gold deposit accounts.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (TCMB)

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance and Private Pension Regulation and Supervision Agency (SEDDK)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Ministry of Family and Social Services (needs-based old-age pension, 65 yaş aylığı)

publicHealthCover.name: General Health Insurance (GSS), Social Security Institution
